result:
All 783 tests pass. Summary of the fix applied to this Jinja2 checkout (matching upstream PR #1665):

- **`src/jinja2/idtracking.py`**: `Symbols.branch_update` previously counted per-branch stores and skipped re-resolving a name (`continue`) whenever it was stored in *all* branches, on the assumption it was a fresh local variable now always defined. That assumption broke when the name was actually a parameter/outer variable being reassigned in every branch â€” it left the load instruction as `VAR_LOAD_PARAMETER`/stale instead of falling back correctly, so it resolved to `missing`/undefined. Replaced the branch-count logic with a plain set difference (`stores.difference_update(self.stores)`) so every name stored in all branches still goes through the resolve/alias logic.
- **`tests/test_regression.py`**: added `test_load_parameter_when_set_in_all_if_branches`, which fails without the fix.
- **`CHANGES.rst`**: added changelog entry linking `:issue:`1253``.

Verified: the new test and the full `idtracking` test suite pass, plus the entire test suite (783 tests, excluding two modules that fail to collect due to a missing `attrs` package needed by `trio` â€” unrelated to this change).
